description: Land Acquisition - Madawala, Polgolla, Nawayalathenna and Kahalla Division No. 10, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and locations. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisitions and property-related administrative matters, not government personnel or structural changes.
